title: LCPS project registry
description: Editor and test aid for projects_registry.json. project_config.load_project_config is the authoritative check; it also refuses what this schema cannot express, e.g. sheet_id equal to test_sheet_id, or a log tab named after a metadata tab. Stricter than the loader where the loader normalizes instead of refusing: a whitespace-padded batch_column, a non-string log tab or description, and a mediatype outside the enum below are rejected here but accepted by the loader.

$schema.description: Path to this schema, for editor validation. Ignored by the tool.

collection_key.description: First part of every minted identifier (COLLECTIONKEY-PROJECTID-NUMBER). Not the IA collection items land in; that is ia_collection.

projects.description: Project id -> its configuration. The project id is the identifier's second part.

identifierPart.$comment: (?!\n) stops Python's $ (used by jsonschema) from accepting a trailing newline.
identifierPart.description: Lowercase letters and digits only; hyphens separate an identifier's parts.

normalizedColumnName.description: A Sheet header after normalization: lowercased, punctuation dropped, spaces to underscores. "Theme Name" is written theme_name.

description.description: Human note. Not read by the tool.

mediatype.description: IA mediatype sent with every item, e.g. image. Cannot be changed after upload.

ia_collection.description: IA collection a --live run uploads into. Test runs always use test_collection.

sheet_id.description: Live Google Sheet document id. A value starting REPLACE_WITH is a placeholder that live runs refuse. Must differ from test_sheet_id.

test_sheet_id.description: Google Sheet document id read by test (non --live) runs.

sheet_tab.description: Metadata tab name; the default when live_sheet_tab / test_sheet_tab is unset.

live_sheet_tab.description: Metadata tab name in the live document only. Blank means unset.

test_sheet_tab.description: Metadata tab name in the test document only. Blank means unset.

upload_log_tab.description: Tab upload appends its run summary to. Absent or blank: no mirroring. Must not be a metadata tab.

sync_log_tab.description: Tab sync-metadata appends its run summary to. Absent or blank: no mirroring. Must not be a metadata tab.

files_dir.description: Root folder the resolved file paths are relative to.

file_template.description: Builds a row's file path from normalized column names, e.g. {folder_on_lacie_drive}/{file_name}.

required_for_upload.description: Columns a human must fill in before a row can upload. No default by design.

batch_column.description: Column --batch matches against. Absent: --batch is unavailable.

photo_extensions.description: File extensions that count as photos. Case and leading dot are optional. Default: .jpg .jpeg .tif .tiff .png.
